pca.pitfall_note: Without standardization, features with large scales (like CodingTestScore: 0-100) dominate 85%+ of variance, completely drowning out CGPA (4-10).

isolation_forest.description: Isolation Forest isolates anomalies by randomly selecting a feature and split value. Outliers have noticeably shorter average path lengths in the trees.
